message.content:
To rotate \(z\) around \(c\) by \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) counter-clockwise, use

\[
w = c + e^{i\pi/4}(z-c).
\]

First compute

\[
z-c = \left(2+\sqrt2-(3+3\sqrt2)i\right) - (2-3i)
= \sqrt2 - 3\sqrt2 i
= \sqrt2(1-3i).
\]

Since

\[
e^{i\pi/4} = \frac{1+i}{\sqrt2},
\]

we have

\[
e^{i\pi/4}(z-c)
= \frac{1+i}{\sqrt2}\cdot \sqrt2(1-3i)
= (1+i)(1-3i).
\]

Now

\[
(1+i)(1-3i)=1-3i+i-3i^2=1-2i+3=4-2i.
\]

Thus

\[
w = c + (4-2i) = (2-3i)+(4-2i)=6-5i.
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{6-5i}\).
